caption: The drawing depicts a square textile, possibly a quilt, laid out flat. The main body of the textile features four large circular, starburst-like patterns arranged in a two-by-two grid. Each starburst consists of alternating elongated green and red points with a yellowish diamond lattice pattern overlaying the red sections, radiating out from a solid, light-colored circular center. The background fabric is off-white and covered with densely stitched, curving quilt lines that form a swirling, feather-like texture around the starbursts. Along the right and bottom edges, there is a decorative border composed of a red diamond-patterned ribbon intertwined with a solid green ribbon, both curling in broad arcs and tied into bows at intervals. The background outside the main textile is plain and cream-colored, and the bottom right corner of the drawing features the name "Catherine Fowler" in small, neat writing.
title: Bedspread
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
